analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($61.94) vs SMA5 ($68.61)/SMA20 ($73.82)/SMA50 ($73.53): trading below short- to mid-term trends, indicating weak positioning.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.1→33.9): entering oversold territory, probing for rebound potential.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.4262→-0.9552): weak trend persists with signs of improvement, dead cross maintained.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $61.07): approaching lower band, confirming oversold pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($57.59): support level based on 52-week low.
· Swing Resistance ($74.18): resistance level based on 50-day moving average.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High): confirming continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.77x): decline accompanied by surge in volume, suggesting strong selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): short-term rebound attempts present but trend reversal unconfirmed, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
